builds.note: Measured 2026-10-31 on S100P (HBRT 4.7.5). EPE/bad-N against ground truth on held-out ETH3D + Middlebury 2021 scenes (crop 33, resize 51, disparity 0<gt<192); quant_epe is against the build's own float model. Latency is hrt_model_exec perf, 1 thread, 200 frames.

retired_builds.name: las2_m_crop_nashm
retired_builds.why: calibration set had no near field; output clipped at 131 px

retired_builds.name: las2_m_int16_nashm
retired_builds.why: resize calibration had no near field; output clipped at 47.7 px. Held-out (51) EPE 2.17 px vs 0.60 for the resize2 build

licence.tier: A — redistributable, one thing to check first
licence.detail: MIT on the code repo and MIT declared on the published weights. The caveat is upstream of that: the release was produced partly by distilling FoundationStereo, whose NVIDIA licence is research-only. That term binds the LAS2 authors rather than being one they passed downstream, but it is the single item worth a look before a commercial build.

toolchain.note: Recorded so a future failure can be attributed. The host HBDK and the board HBRT must match; 3.7.0 host pairs with 4.0.5 board.

measured.note: Historical: measured on the RETIRED las2_m_crop_nashm build. The EPE here is against the float model on a pair inside the calibration set and flatters the build; see builds above and README trap 4. Measured on S100P with the SHIPPED crop build, not the rebuild below. Latency is from hrt_model_exec perf on a quiet board -- a board with a crashed process leaking VPU/BPU resources reports substantially worse until reboot.

node_info.output_data_type: si16 on 642 nodes, si8 on 16 -- confirms set_all_nodes_int16
node_info.caution: Per-layer cosine is a localisation tool, not a gate: two thirds of layers sit below 0.99 while the model output is 0.999954.

rejected_builds.name: int8 (all)
rejected_builds.why: Fast, and wrong: ~1px systematic disparity offset plus speckle. soft-argmax accumulates softmax quantisation error rather than cancelling it.

rejected_builds.name: mixed precision (cost volume + head int16)
rejected_builds.why: The counter-intuitive one. Scattered int8/int16 boundaries make requant dominate: 6x SLOWER than quantising everything to int16, for worse accuracy.

rebuild.note: This repo's recipe re-run on OE 3.7.0. It is NOT the shipped binary and cannot be: the shipped crop build calibrated on 15 stereo pairs from an uncommitted capture set, while the upstream repo ships only 5.

layer_C_hbm_vs_onnx.note: max error is in occlusion/border pixels; the disparity field is otherwise sub-pixel

board_verification.note: First full three-layer close-out in this repo. Uses the rebuild (5-pair calibration), not the shipped binary.
